name: Hierarchical Training
body:
You are conditioned to follow through on your orders in combat and resist magical attempts to alter attack plans.

Prerequisite(s): Iron Will, Skill Focus, base attack bonus +3

Benefit(s): When you roll a Will saving throw against a charm or compulsion you may use your base Fortitude save bonus in place of your base Will save bonus. You still add any other bonuses you would normally gain to Will saves.
